findings.title: Call to a nonexistent no-argument passkeys helper prevents compilation
findings.body: `UsernameForm` invokes `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled()` with no arguments, but its superclass only defines `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled(UserModel)` (and no inherited no-argument overload is present). This is a Java compilation error, so the services module cannot be built. Pass `context.getUser()` (or add the intended overload) before merging.

findings.title: Initial unauthenticated passkey login no longer initializes the WebAuthn form
findings.body: The new shared condition calls `fillContextForm` only when `context.getUser()` is non-null, because `isConditionalPasskeysEnabled` explicitly requires a user. On the initial login page there is normally no selected user, so no WebAuthn challenge or conditional-UI form attributes are generated. As a result the login form no longer renders/starts the passkey conditional UI for unauthenticated users, breaking the normal passwordless/passkey login path (and contradicting the existing tests that expect `#webauth` on the first page). Preserve the previous realm-feature check for the initial no-user form, while also enabling the selected-user reauthentication case.
